spec_provenance.source: regenerated with 7.1's own sweep code and hash construction

what_this_is: 7.1's OWN per-kernel synthesized binaries, each compiled as its own translation unit with its own per-kernel cudaMalloc calls, all LINKED into one executable driven by ONE process with ONE CUDA context. Removes the executable/memory-environment confound while keeping the shared context that produced the speed.
confound_removed: 7.1: one binary per kernel_hash, own main, own cudaMalloc sized to that kernel's arity. My earlier warm arm: ONE binary, all 8 kernels, dispatch switch, FOUR buffers of the MAXIMUM size regardless of arity. Same isolation, same estimator, different executable and different memory footprint.
protocol_note: each spec is ONE invocation of 5 warmup + 20 timed, so this arm has 40 timed launches per example: each of 7.1's binaries is called TWICE, because 7.1 ran 2 invocations of (5 warmup + 20 timed) and reusing its binaries unmodified means reusing its invocation loop.
